chain.title: An Edge Made Of End Stone
chain.desc: End stone and popped chorus fruit. Farmer's Delight cutting boards need a knife and the End has no iron; this is the local answer.

chain.title: Milling The Chorus
chain.desc: Knife a chorus fruit on a cutting board. Grain is the flour of the End and it appears in almost every recipe here.

chain.title: Grinding A Pearl
chain.desc: Knife an ender pearl. It turns the End's currency into an ingredient, which is the joke the whole mod is built on.

chain.title: Drying The Flower
chain.desc: Smelt or campfire a chorus flower. Dried, it stops propagating and starts being food.

chain.title: A Stove Built On End Stone
chain.desc: Campfire, end stone bricks and popped chorus fruit. Farmer's Delight's stove rebuilt from materials the End actually has.

chain.title: The Sauce Of The Outer Islands
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: chorus grain, chorus succulent and chorus fruit. It binds the sausage, noodle and dragon-steak lines together.

chain.title: Butchering An Enderman
chain.desc: Endermen drop gristle through data/ends_delight/loot_modifiers/add_enderman_gristle.json. The first meat the End will give you.

chain.title: Very Small Cuts
chain.desc: Endermites drop meat through their own loot modifier. Tiny, plentiful, and the base of the congee.

chain.title: Cured In The Void
chain.desc: Smoked, smelted or campfired. Drying is what makes endermite meat worth carrying.

chain.title: Prising Open A Shulker
chain.desc: Shulkers drop meat through add_shulker_meat.json. End cities become a food source as well as a loot source.

chain.title: Shulker, Roasted
chain.desc: Campfire, furnace or smoker. The best sustained food in the End before the dragon dies.

chain.title: A Shulker Feast
chain.desc: Roasted shulker with chorus succulent, onion, tomato and a shell. A block-sized meal that serves a table.

chain.title: The Dragon Is Also Meat
chain.desc: The Ender Dragon drops raw meat through add_dragon_meat.json and add_extra_dragon_meat.json. Killing the dragon is now a cooking prerequisite.

chain.title: An Entire Leg
chain.desc: The dragon's own loot modifier drops a single leg. It is the biggest joint of meat in the game.

chain.title: Smoked Over Days
chain.desc: The leg cured rather than seared, which is what the sauced plate recipe needs.

chain.title: A Tooth Worth Keeping
chain.desc: Also a dragon drop. It is the reagent for the fake egg and the smithing template for the mod's best knife.

chain.title: An Egg That Will Never Open
chain.desc: Dragon tooth, an end crystal and obsidian. Vanilla gives you one dragon egg ever; this makes as many as you can afford.

chain.title: Cracked With A Nether Star
chain.desc: Cutting a non-hatchable egg on a board needs a nether star as the tool. The single most expensive cutting recipe in the ecosystem.

chain.title: What Was Inside
chain.desc: The other half of the cracked egg. Fry it and it becomes the mod's rarest breakfast.

chain.title: A Knife Made Of Shell
chain.desc: Half an egg shell and popped chorus fruit. Sharper than end stone, and the base of the final upgrade.

chain.title: The Last Knife
chain.desc: Smithing a dragon tooth onto the shell knife with a netherite template. The end of the End's cutlery.

chain.title: Dragon, Stewed
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: raw dragon meat, chorus grain, chorus succulent, an egg shell, tomato, carrot and potato. Seven ingredients, all of them End-gated.

chain.title: Noodles Of The Outer Islands
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: chorus sauce, dried endermite meat, pasta, shulker meat and three mushrooms. The mod's most demanding assembly.

chain.title: Drinking The Dragon's Breath
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: dragon breath, dried chorus flower, chorus fruit and suspicious stew. It uses the one vanilla item nobody has a use for.

notes: 63 ids resolve as assets/ends_delight/models/item/<id>.json intersected with item./block. lang keys. Every mob-drop claim is checked against data/ends_delight/loot_modifiers/: add_dragon_leg, add_dragon_meat, add_extra_dragon_meat, add_dragon_tooth, add_shulker_meat, add_enderman_gristle, add_endermite_meat and add_dried_endermite_meat. The chain is deliberately gated the way the recipes are: everything before enderman_gristle only needs chorus fruit and end stone, everything from raw_dragon_meat onward requires the Ender Dragon to be dead. The standout mechanic, read from data/ends_delight/recipes/crack_non_hatchable_dragon_egg.json, is that cracking the crafted dragon egg on a cutting board takes minecraft:nether_star as the TOOL rather than a knife - the most expensive cutting-board recipe in the whole Farmer's Delight ecosystem, and the gate on the final knife. ends_delight registers no entities and no dimensions of its own. Parent items this addon assumes you already have: farmersdelight:cutting_board, farmersdelight:cooking_pot, farmersdelight:pie_crust, farmersdelight:tomato and onion crops, farmersdelight:rice, a killed Ender Dragon, End City access for shulkers.
